resources.string: A familiar workspace, wherever you are.
Your desktop is one connection away
Add a Windows or RDP computer. Your profiles stay on this device unless you choose to sync them.
Optional WebDAV sync keeps your connection list with you. Passwords stay local by default.
For NLA connections made by IP address. Leave blank unless your server requires its computer name.
The password is encrypted on this device. An empty password is kept as an intentional empty password.
Choose a name you will recognize, then enter the computer address.
Optional settings for domain and NLA sign-in.
No password saved · edit to add one
This profile has no password. Enter one explicitly and save before connecting.
The saved password cannot be decrypted. Its original encrypted data is preserved. Entering a new password and saving explicitly replaces it; leaving it blank cannot save.
You will be asked to verify a new or changed server certificate before sign-in credentials are sent.
Remove “%1$s” and its saved credentials from this device. This does not delete the remote computer or its files.
Enter a connection name and host to continue.
Your own WebDAV, your connection list.
Default sync sends profiles only (rdpsync_profiles.json), never RDP passwords. Backups are not end-to-end encrypted; use HTTPS. Older clients only recognize the legacy password file.
The saved WebDAV password cannot be decrypted. Re-enter it explicitly; leaving it blank will not overwrite the original.
Profiles only · rdpsync_profiles.json\nRDP passwords are not sent and the legacy cloud file is untouched. Import preserves existing local passwords and devices.
Read an older client’s backup. Passwords will be imported into encrypted local storage. An explicitly empty password updates the local password.
Warning: RDP passwords will be uploaded as readable plain text. HTTPS protects transport only, not the backup itself. The server and anyone with file access can read them.
Merge prefers local profiles. To import changes from an older client, choose download and the legacy file.
This profile has no password. Edit the connection and enter one before connecting.
The saved credentials cannot be decrypted. Edit this connection and re-enter the password.
The address or server name is invalid. The certificate cannot be verified safely.
Input was busy. Held keys have been safely released; please try again.
Text input was interrupted and may be incomplete. Check the remote text before retrying.
The certificate response does not match this connection. Connection refused.
File transfer could not start. Reconnect to try again.
File-transfer capability could not be checked. Your desktop is still connected; reconnect to try again.
Touch negotiation failed. Trying the compatibility connection…
Certificate trust canceled. No sign-in credentials were sent.
Trackpad: slide to move the pointer, tap to click. Hold for right-click; hold and move to drag.
Direct touch · pinch to zoom or pan. In compatibility mode, hold for right-click or hold and move to drag.

Clipboard file transfer must be enabled when connecting, so this briefly disconnects your desktop. Save remote work first. Enabling the protocol does not access phone files or watch the clipboard. You must still choose and confirm each transfer. Regular files only; this is not a redirected drive.
Trust could not be saved, or the certificate request changed. No reconnection was made. Cancel, retry and verify again.
This briefly disconnects your desktop and reconnects with the selected resolution. Your work in remote apps will not be saved automatically.
Text is sent as keyboard input. The remote clipboard is not replaced.
Clipboard copy/paste for explicitly selected files. Not a shared drive. First use requires a confirmed reconnect; phone directories are not shared.
With a fixed resolution and adaptive quality off, quality only changes the local frame-rate limit. It does not silently lower the remote resolution.
Adapt to network and rendering load
Adaptive quality uses measured latency, bandwidth and render time. It reduces quality only after sustained slowdown, then recovers gradually. It does not guess when measurements are missing.

Tap to click, hold for right-click, or hold and move to drag. Pinch and pan change only your local view. Resolution is negotiated with the server without stretching; older servers require a manual reconnect.

Verify the fingerprint independently before trusting a new or changed certificate. This is manual fingerprint pinning (TOFU), not CA identity validation. Sync may contain credentials; use only trusted HTTPS WebDAV.
This certificate differs from the trusted fingerprint. It may be a legitimate update or an interception attack. Do not continue without independent verification.
This server is not yet trusted. The connection stopped before sign-in credentials were sent. Verify the entire SHA-256 fingerprint with the administrator or another trusted channel.
I verified this SHA-256 fingerprint through an independent channel
The fingerprint is saved only for this profile, address, port and server name. Other hosts are not automatically trusted.
Clipboard files · not a shared drive
Regular files only, not folders or disguised ZIPs. Up to 64 files; receive limit 128 MiB per file and 256 MiB in private staging.
File transfer is not supported in this session.
Checking send allowance · 32 MiB total per connection
Send allowance left: %1$d bytes · 32 MiB (33554432 bytes) per connection
Repeated, failed or canceled reads may count toward the allowance. Canceling does not restore it. Only a manual reconnect resets it; there is no automatic reconnect or resume.
Reconnect for a new send session
Reconnecting briefly interrupts the desktop and withdraws the file offer. Save remote work first; then select and offer files again.
Only files you explicitly choose are read and copied to private staging. Phone directories are not shared and the system clipboard is not watched.
The selection exceeds this connection’s remaining allowance and has not been offered. Choose fewer files, or reconnect explicitly and select again.

After offering, paste in the remote file manager. Offered or read does not mean saved: confirm the files remotely. Closing this dialog does not stop confirmed transfers; stop sharing or disconnect to withdraw the offer.
Copy files in the remote file manager, then read the file list here. Content downloads only after you confirm.
Export creates a new file in your chosen folder, never overwrites. Interruptions or provider failures may leave an incomplete new copy. The complete staged file remains until the session ends.
Waiting for the system picker. Canceling will not send or export files.
Copying selected files to private staging…
Files offered · paste on the remote desktop
Received · choose a folder to export
Creating a new file in your chosen folder…
This selection expired or the connection changed. Nothing was read or exported; choose again.
Selection canceled. No files were sent.
Export canceled. Staged files are still available.
The picker is still open or the connection changed. Try again later.
The system picker could not open. No files were read or exported.
Closing this dialog does not cancel the connection test.
